settings.heading: Crafted for Character, Bottled with Elegance
settings.text:
Balad Perfumes started with a simple passion: to craft luxurious, long-lasting fragrances and pure attars that tell a story with every note.

We blend artisanal craftsmanship with rich, premium oils, creating unique scents designed to evoke emotion, elegance, and confidence for every occasion. Every bottle is crafted with care, bringing you unforgettable signature scents.

settings.heading: Numbers that speak for our passion

settings.title: Artisanal Blends
settings.text: Every fragrance is carefully formulated using pure concentrated oils and fine perfume notes.

settings.title: Long-Lasting Projection
settings.text: Crafted to linger beautifully throughout the day with rich, multi-layered notes.

settings.title: Premium Packaging
settings.text: Housed in elegant bottles and boxes, perfect for self-indulgence or luxury gifting.

settings.title: Doorstep Delivery & Care
settings.text: Swiftly dispatched across India with express delivery, Cash on Delivery, and premium packaging.

settings.heading: Crafted for Character, Built for Elegance.
settings.text: We combine exquisite perfume oils, refined bottles, and captivating accords to make every scent uniquely yours.

settings.question: Are all Balad perfumes long-lasting?
settings.answer: Yes! Our perfumes and attars are crafted with high concentration oil blends designed for exceptional longevity and sillage.

settings.question: Where are your physical stores located?
settings.answer: We have flagship retail stores in Calicut and Thekkady, Kerala, where you can sample our full collection in person.

settings.question: Do you offer express delivery across India?
settings.answer: Yes, we ship express across India with Cash on Delivery options and real-time tracking from our store to your door.

settings.question: How do I choose the right fragrance?
settings.answer: Each perfume product page details top, heart, and base notes. You can also contact our team for personalized fragrance recommendations.
